name: Auth Your Agent
description: Let AI agents act for a person on websites, with the person's approval on their phone. The agent's browser runs in a sandboxed vault it cannot read into; when a site asks for a password, CAPTCHA or 2FA, the owner takes over from their phone.

installation.command: pip install "authyouragent[mcp]" && authyouragent vault up --agent-id ag_... --key <agent key file>

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open a public website in the vault's browser.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by its number from read_page (or a CSS selector). Clicks that submit, send, delete, pay or publish ask the owner's phone first.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type into a form field. Never used for the owner's passwords or codes.

tools.name: select_option
tools.description: Choose an entry in a dropdown by its visible text. Asks the owner first if choosing sends data to the site.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press Enter, Space, Tab, Escape, arrows and the like. Enter or Space that submits or commits asks the owner first.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll down, up, to the top or bottom, or to an element; loads more on endless pages.

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until some text appears or disappears, or the page stops loading.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: A JPEG of what the browser shows, for models with vision.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read the page: URL, title, visible text, and a numbered list of links, buttons, fields and dropdowns to act on. Password values are never shown.

tools.name: check_login_wall
tools.description: Report whether the page is blocked by a sign-in, CAPTCHA, one-time code or sign-in approval.

tools.name: list_secrets
tools.description: List the sign-ins the owner shared from their Bitwarden or Vaultwarden: names, sites and fields, never values.

tools.name: fill_secret
tools.description: Fill a username, password or authenticator code from the owner's password manager. The agent never sees the value.

tools.name: request_takeover
tools.description: Ask the owner to take over the browser from their phone. Returns done, cancelled, expired, incomplete, or waiting.

tools.name: wait_for_takeover
tools.description: Keep waiting for a take over that request_takeover reported as still waiting.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: Sign out of every site used, then destroy the browser profile.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Ask the owner to approve a sensitive action. Returns approved, denied or expired.

tools.name: notify_owner
tools.description: Send the owner a one-way note on their phone, e.g. done or stuck. Nothing to approve.

tools.name: check_agent_status
tools.description: Check whether the agent is still authorized. The owner can revoke it at any time.

tools.name: report_site
tools.description: Report a site where take over did not work correctly.

tools.name: save_secret
tools.description: After the owner signs in during a take over, offer to save that sign-in to their password manager. The owner confirms on their phone; the agent never sees it.

tools.name: submit_plan
tools.description: Ask the owner once, in advance, to pre-approve the exact steps of a scheduled task, for a set number of daily or weekly runs.

tools.name: plan_status
tools.description: The state of a submitted plan: for each step, whether it is approved, done or skipped.
